Head of Department (2025 — 2026) • In Memoriam

Prof. E.W. Mangset

"A father, a trainer, a teacher, a mentor, and a role model."

Prof. E.W. Mangset served as the Head of our Physics Department from 2025 until we sadly lost him in May 2026. He was a truly caring teacher and a guiding light for every student in our department. His teachings, kindness, and wonderful advice will forever remain in our hearts.
